name: clipboard-saver

scripts.release:commit: git add -A && git commit -m "Clipboard-Saver 2.4.0: fullscreen media viewer, favorite-star title bar, redesigned tooltips, screenshot fixes, expert-menu polish"
scripts.release:publish: gh release create v2.4.0 src-tauri/target/release/clipboard-saver.exe "src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis/Clipboard-Saver_2.4.0_x64-setup.exe" --title "Clipboard-Saver 2.4.0" --repo wbgcoding/Clipboard-Saver --notes-file docs/release-notes.md
